rule.statement: The onus shifts to the defendants to show that the disability had ceased on some subsequent date and that the adverse possession relied on had uninterruptedly continued thereafter for a period of ten years.
rule.supporting_quote: Once that has been established, the onus shifts once again to the other side to show that the disability had ceased on some subsequent date and that the adverse possession relied on had uninterruptedly continued thereafter for a period of ten years.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 13, prescription did not in fact run from the date on which the adverse possession first commenced.
